messages:
maya: Heads-up — during today's H200 soak we saw intermittent packet drops on the APAC interconnects. L40S warm pools timed out on a small subset of shard attaches. Affects capacity we planned to shift to APAC for the holiday surge.

oliver: Any numbers on drop rate / affected pods?

maya: Around 0.6% of egress connections from apac-cluster-2 over last 3 hours. Affected ~12 pods, 2 failed restarts. CPU/mem fine, network errors only.

sasha: Do we know if it's vendor-level congestion or our VPC peering?

infra-bot: Alert: apac-cluster-2 interconnect packet-drop > 0.5% (03:10Z - 06:20Z). Linked logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/xyz

maya: Initial triage points to elevated latency on the provider side between apac edge and our backbone. Peering metrics show queueing.

rachel: This is bad timing — procurement has H200 shipment windows queued. If lead times slip we'll have to backfill with L40S or H100 temporary capacity. Cost delta: H200 ~2.8x L40S, H100 ~1.6x L40S by current quotes.

procurement-bot: Current vendor ETAs: H200 stock ETA windows: 13-16 weeks; H100 replenishment: 8-10 weeks; L40S immediate (spot + 2-week reserved).

oliver: For Q4 we were targeting +7M GPU-hours across regions. If APAC is constrained, we need a fallback plan that doesn't blow budget. Any quick throughput sims?

maya: Short simulation: move 40% of APAC burst to US-EAST H100 pools, keep latency-sensitive routes local on L40S. That preserves 85% of our p99 SLA, raises token cost ~18%.

oliver: Can we do smart routing to send low-priority, high-throughput batch jobs to H100 in US and keep real-time chat to L40S in APAC?

sasha: Yes — can set routing policy by priority + latency-slack. Example snippet: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - name: apac-fallback
    match: region == apac && priority == low
    action: route(region=us-east, model_variant=H100-batched)
  - name: apac-preserve-low-latency
    match: region == apac && priority == realtime
    action: route(region=apac, model_variant=L40S-local)
```

rachel: Cost tradeoff table (quick):
- Replace 10k H200-hours with H100 => +40% throughput variance, -30% cost relative to H200 but +60% vs L40S.
- Replace with L40S => maintain latency SLA but need more instances; slightly higher ops complexity.

oliver: We should also consider short-term rental (cloud burst) for holiday weeks — cheaper than losing requests. What's the egress cost hit?

maya: Inter-region egress will add ~0.9c per 1k tokens when crossing APAC->US. If we route 30% of APAC burst to US, incremental egress ~ $12k/week for peak weeks. Still cheaper than SLA penalties.

procurement-bot: Vendor negotiation note: If we commit to 24-mo reserved capacity, H200 lead time can be prioritized to 10-12 weeks with down-payment. Also can split delivery across 2 shipments to mitigate single-region supply risk.

sasha: Ops action: throttle nightly evals and long-form generation jobs to off-peak in APAC to free up warm pool headroom. Quick patch: add rate limit rule on /evals route from 22:00-05:00 APAC.

oliver: Agreed. Also run a capacity sim for worst-case (20% extra demand) with the smart routing rules and L40S warm pool scaling. Can you run that today?

maya: I'll run sim and upload results. If simulation shows >95% p99 risk, we trigger procurement plan B (rent H100 capacity short-term + split H200 shipments).

rachel: I'll draft procurement options: A) commit to prioritized H200 delivery (24-mo reserve), B) staggered H200+H100 mix, C) L40S-heavy approach with cloud burst overlay.

oliver: Timeline: need sims by EOD, procurement options by tomorrow morning, and a short runbook for on-call to toggle routing failovers if packet drops resurface.

maya: Will do. Creating ticket: INFRA-1248, attaching sims and routing snippets.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-1248 - APAC interconnect fallback plan. Assigned: maya, oliver, sasha.

sasha: I'll also open a cloud interconnect support case with provider (ref #CI-APAC-338).

rachel: If anyone wants cost numbers for exec summary, ping me and I'll run the delta with expected egress and rental numbers.

oliver: Thanks all. Keep replies short in this thread — escalate to #incidents if it becomes widespread. :thumbsup:
